title: ElevenLabs Agent Workflows: Build Multi-Step Voice Agents
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: ElevenLabs Agent Workflows: Build Multi-Step Voice Agents.

Agent Workflows turn one long prompt into a visual graph of steps. This episode explains every node type in ElevenAgents workflows: subagents, say nodes, dispatch tool nodes, update state, agent transfer, transfer to number and end nodes. It covers forward and backward edges, LLM conditions vs expressions, a worked support-flow example, the workflow JSON for version control, and how workflow analytics shows where callers drop off.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
